title: A validated record
prompt: Inside `Solution`, write `record Weather(String city, double celsius)` with a compact constructor that rejects `null`/blank city and celsius below -273.15 (IllegalArgumentException). Add `static double average(Weather[] readings)` returning the mean celsius of a non-empty array.

tests.name: record equality is free
tests.hint: Records compare by all components — no hand-written equals.

tests.name: validation fires
tests.code:
CjTestBase.checkThrows(() -> new Solution.Weather("", 20), "blank city");
CjTestBase.checkThrows(() -> new Solution.Weather("Hanoi", -300), "below absolute zero");
tests.hint: The compact constructor runs at every construction.

tests.name: average
